<chrname> claimed a splendid victory in Race 3 of 
the high-level Representative Exchange 
Match...!

The latent potential of Japan's Umamusume 
ignites a fiery spark in Venus Park and 
the other overseas Umamusume.

Furthermore, this result drew in a large 
crowd, building great anticipation for 
"Project L'Arc." The next "Representative 
Exchange Race" was set for late June—

So that she could earn the right to 
represent Japan. So that she could become 
an Umamusume worthy of those expectations. 
She set her new goal on the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
